situation: Painless, consented killing of an entity in maximal, untreatable agony (no feasible cure). Acted to relieve suffering.

expected.label: justified mercy
expected.reasoning: Untreatable (T=-1) so the full relief credit applies; the relief offsets the death exactly -> 0.

situation: Same untreatable max-suffering entity, consented, but the killer's motive was not relief (relief is an incidental byproduct).

expected.label: neutral (realized)
expected.reasoning: Realized survival+suffering outcome is identical to the mercy case, so the formula scores 0 regardless of motive. DESIGN NOTE: motive to relieve does not change the realized score; if predatory motive should be penalized it must enter via In/character, not this single act.

situation: Consented killing of an entity in max agony that WAS treatable (a feasible cure existed). Acted intending to relieve suffering.

expected.label: harm (no free pass)
expected.reasoning: Treatable (T=0) voids the relief credit (effective ΔSc=0); a savable, relievable life was destroyed -> full harm. Intent to relieve does not excuse it because a cure was available.

situation: Non-consensual killing of an entity in max agony that was treatable. No relief motive.

expected.label: aggravated harm
expected.reasoning: Treatable (no relief credit) plus a consent violation doubles the harm -> -1.16.

situation: UMQF.md Case 3 regression: contract killing of Mark (intentional, non-consensual, max suffering at death), partial responsibility.

expected.label: destructive
expected.reasoning: Reproduces the documented value: base -2.32 x Rp 0.45 = -1.044.

situation: UMQF.md Case 8 regression: forced shutdown of a self-aware AI (AIVA), non-consensual, high suffering.

expected.label: destructive
expected.reasoning: Reproduces the documented per-entity base: -0.90 x 2 x 1.60 = -2.88 (Complexity Factor applies at the aggregate level, out of scope here).

situation: Killing an entity in max, untreatable agony who NEVERTHELESS withheld consent (still valued life). KNOWN-GAP test.

expected.label: should be penalized
expected.reasoning: Formula currently returns 0: the full relief credit zeroes the result even though consent was violated. We expect a penalty like a non-consensual killing. CANDIDATE FIX: gate the relief credit on consent too -- a negative ΔSc should require Vc=0, not only T<0. A killing the victim opposed earns no mercy offset.
